profile.headline: Looking at new opportunities
profile.summary:
I was a Senior Software Engineer and Technical Specialist with over 30 years of hands-on experience designing, developing, and maintaining enterprise-scale software systems—primarily in telecommunications and secure, server-side web applications.

My background spans legacy platforms and modern full-stack technologies. I’ve worked extensively with Java (JSF, JSP, JNLP, Install4j), PostgreSQL, MariaDB, Apache servers, and scripting languages (Perl, Shell, Bash, Python), along with application servers like JBoss, Wildfly, and Glassfish. I also bring strong front-end integration experience using PrimeFaces, jQuery, and custom UI components.

I began my career developing calling features for the DMS-100 telecom switch, moved into publishing systems (KODAK Imaging, Xerox DocuTech), and have since spent decades at Evans Griffiths & Hart creating secure software solutions for major telecom clients across North America.

What sets me apart is my ability to bridge legacy systems with modern architecture—solving real-world problems where performance, security, and reliability matter. I’ve led UI design initiatives, supported enterprise deployments, and maintained complex infrastructure in production environments.

🔍 I’m currently exploring opportunities in:
- Senior Backend or Java Development
- Legacy Systems Modernization
- Telecom Software Consulting
- Solution Architecture & Infrastructure Modernization

Whether in a leadership, contributor, or consulting role, I bring decades of proven experience and a passion for delivering thoughtful, resilient solutions.
